title: ST-2 late mortar fallback for gun-only bots after 45 s
source: Mech Sim Tester death report /workspace/tester/proposals/20261121-2153-0e6fadd.md (ST-2), PR #154
change: When still gun-only after LASER_RUSH_S with a free slot, allow a reachable in-zone ground mortar as the lowest-priority pickup, behind laser and lightning (brain.ts loot rule ~:496 and the Build 80 late trip ~:684-700; held-mortar fire code ~:1098 already exists).
why: Gun-only is 141/384 games (36.7%) at slice score 1.82, the weakest loadout; the champion's top loss is no laser at the end.
risks: Holding a mortar takes +60% laser damage (cook-off); laser beats mortar; slow shells may do worse on the site than in the sim.
step_a: Log only, trees-on on P34: count gun-only-after-45 s games with a reachable in-zone mortar seen and no enemy within 160 m, on 2000+3000 and 4000+5000. Fewer than 10/192 on either set: retire, no build.
novelty: No prior site test picks up a mortar (EXPERIMENTS.md has no mortar entries).
